name: 引用と写真を添える文脈付き返信
prompt:
Correct LH03-0153 v001 against the native Japanese preview. Keep the exact 390:144 canvas ratio, white background, text placement, spacing, horizontal alignment, and all visible Japanese wording. Make only the control-shape corrections.

Keep 「みんなの読書会」へのメッセージ on the first line and 「返信を入力してください」 below it. Preserve the image-attachment icon and quote/context icon at the lower left in the same order and at the same small size as the native preview. The quote/context icon must look like the native quotation/reply glyph, not paragraph symbols, boxed letters, or two outlined P shapes. Keep the image icon simple and gray.

At lower right, use a flat, solid forest-green circle about 44 logical pixels across, with no gradient, texture, or shadow. Match the native preview's small white paper-plane arrow; do not enlarge or embellish it. Preserve the clean, compact 390×144 composer row. No hyperlink text is present, so add no blue text. Do not add frames, decorations, avatars, photos, or other controls.

settings.correction: Use quotation marks and flat native send control

reviewNotes: 第2版を目視。引用/文脈アイコンは第1版の¶風から引用符形へ改善。日本語2行、画像アイコン、緑の送信円と白い紙飛行機を保持。native比で送信円にまだ質感/陰影があり、矢印もやや大きい。2回の限定試行を保存しneeds-correctionのまま次IDへ進む。所有者受入・ネイティブ編集・実動作は未検証。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。

inputReferences.role: Correction target: exact stored LH03-0153 v001
